axis.source: fitted to the 1900 map's house numbers within 22 m of it (29 of them), anchored at its crossing with the Leipziger Straße axis (station 460 there); parallel to Friedrichstraße's within 0.3 degrees, as the Friedrichstadt grid has it; stations in metres north of the Leipziger Straße crossing. OHM has no line for it

first_side: numbers 1-23 go north up the east side from the Jerusalemkirche to Hausvogteiplatz; 24-66 come back down the west from Mohrenstraße to Lindenstraße (the directory's postal line: 1-13 u. 36-66 SW 19, 14-35 C 19)
corners_source: OHM's crossing streets met with the axis (Linden-, Koch-, Zimmer-, Schützen-, Krausen-, Leipziger, Kronenstraße); the Jerusalemkirche's north end from its OHM outline (1879-1945); Hausvogteiplatz and Mohrenstraße from the 1900 map's numbers (east 23 at 174 and Hausvogteiplatz 10 at 186, west 24 at 182); Dönhoffplatz fills the east side between Krausen- and Leipziger Straße, put in its middle
